# MoonBlaster 1.4 replayer (third-party)

- `mbplay_original.src`: `sources/replayer/mbplay.src` from the official MoonBlaster 1.4 development package
  (https://www.msx.org/download/download/2012/06/moonblaster-1.4.zip), by Remco Schrijvers / MoonSoft,
  with MSX compatibility fixes by Albert Beevendorp (BiFi).
- `moonblaster_readme.txt`: the package readme (`sources/readme.txt`) with MoonSoft's terms of use.
- `moonblaster_replayer_readme.txt`: the replayer readme (`sources/replayer/readme.txt`).

The adapted copy used in the ROM is `music/mbplay_rom.asm`, generated by `music/adapt_mbplay.py`.

Terms: the 1997 readme allows use of the MoonBlaster sources for new public-domain music programs.
A note dated July 1, 2012 in the same readme says the restrictions on using the sources were removed.
This is not a formal open-source license. These files remain under MoonSoft's terms and are not covered
by any license of the rest of this repository.
